def peekn(n, seq):
    """ Retrieve the next n elements of a sequence

    Returns a tuple of the first n elements and an iterable equivalent to the
    original sequence, still having the elements retrieved.

    >>> seq = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
    >>> first_two, seq = peekn(2, seq)
    >>> first_two
    (0, 1)
    >>> list(seq)
    [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
    """
    iterator = iter(seq)
    items = tuple(itertools.islice(iterator, n))
    return items, itertools.chain(iter(items), iterator)
